title: AS2: String.fromCharCode emits wrong opcode 0x63 (BitLShift) instead of 0x37 (MBAsciiToChar)
description: In packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts around line 2051, String.fromCharCode() emits 0x63 (ActionBitLShift) instead of 0x37 (ActionMBAsciiToChar). Any AS2 code calling String.fromCharCode() produces a left-shifted number instead of a character. Fix: change emit(0x63) to emit(0x37) in the fromCharCode call-site handler.
